notes: Sheet is rotated: north is to the LEFT (W. Liberty at left edge, Horne along top = east side, Garrard Av. along bottom = west side). Horne, Liberty and Courtland have no suffix printed on this sheet. Wilstach, Wade and Flint are printed '(NOT OPEN)'. Courtland is printed 'COURTLAND (FLORENCE)' on a pasted correction strip at the right edge; only its west side line is on the sheet, centre taken half its 50 ft width (25 ft, about 87 px at ~3.47 px/ft) toward the south (to the right) of that line. Wilstach width printed 48'6". W. Liberty continues west of Garrard (below it on the page) as an iron viaduct over the railroad yard (B&O SW RR) to the bottom edge; the dashed line down Liberty marks the viaduct. Garrard carries the C.M.&R.R.R. on a wood trestle. Nothing but railroad land west of Garrard (below it on the page).
